description: GitHub's server-side records of the pushes to the (then private) sremu repository on 10-11 Oct 2026: the repository-activity export (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/activity: before/after commit, ref, timestamp, pusher) and the events export (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/events, PushEvent records). They are the third-party timestamps of the V-LAB analysis-plan lock (Section V-D) and of the commits that followed it.
data_class_note: PROVENANCE: a server-side process record kept by a third party (GitHub). It is not a measurement of the physical world (MEAS), not an emulator output (SIM-sremu), not a value chosen for a study (ENG) and not a number quoted from a publication (REPORTED). It carries no physical quantity and enters no figure; the paper quotes commit ids and push times from it as dataset facts (numbers.yaml source type data, id V-LAB-provenance), which tools/gen_results.py checks against these files.

source.exported: 2026-10-11, 14:26 UTC per the file names, through the GitHub REST API (the repository was private, so the export needed the owner's access)
source.events_endpoint: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/activity/events (retention: events of the past 30 days, at most 300)

files.content: 15 activity records (14 pushes and the branch creation) of refs/heads/master, 2026-10-10T16:12:17Z to 2026-10-11T12:05:12Z
13 events (11 PushEvent, CreateEvent, WatchEvent); timestamps agree with the activity records within 1 s

byte copy of _regen/vlab_check.json of the pinned regeneration job (research/aws/results/20261011T235822Z_regen_37a552, experiments/regenerate_paper_data.sh, AWS c7i.48xlarge, started 2026-10-11T23:59:37Z)
files.data_class: PROVENANCE (a process record of the emulator's own job, not a third-party record)
files.use: Appendix H: at the regeneration commit the V-LAB protocol and analysis files are byte-identical to 7a63287 and the protocol digest equals the lock; the record itself states that it does not cover the sremu modules the V-LAB code imports. tools/vv_ids.py checks it.

files.checked_commit_source: git rev-parse HEAD of the clean clone used for the paper junit (sremu_paper.meta.json records the same commit, dirty false)
files.data_class: PROVENANCE (a process record of the emulator's own check, not a third-party record)

facts_quoted.lock_commit: 101ee87 (protocol digest d8623254... committed in the emulator; pushed 2026-10-11T00:22:55Z, activity record)
facts_quoted.intermediate_commit: 2ef1401 (pushed 2026-10-11T00:26:33Z). Its content is not in these records; read from the sremu repository's own objects (not a third-party record): validation/ants_fig4b/run.py gains a --columns option (JSON column map for the measured CSV, passed to protocol_lock.load_measured), no other file changed

From the repository objects: relative to 2ef1401 it changes only tests/integration/test_vlab_smoke.py (the 'locked' flag mirrors the committed lock constant); the paper calls the two post-lock commits 'an option of the run script that names the columns of the measured file, and a test change'

not_done: No public deposit (Zenodo, OSF) of the analysis plan was made before unblinding. A deposit can still be made as a retrospective record; the paper says so.
personal_data: Each record names the pushing GitHub account (the corresponding author's public profile fields as returned by the API).
